rationale: The /explore page maps arc AU coordinates through auToPx() per-coordinate (line 350) instead of radially. auToPx is a non-linear compressed-distance scale returning 512 for negative inputs, so intermediate arc points whose x or z goes negative get flung to the canvas edge, warping the arc's middle while the endpoints (often in the first quadrant) land approximately on their orbit rings. Planet positions use cos/sin × orbitR correctly; only the arc mapping applies auToPx to raw Cartesian components.
